Overview

Luque is a city in CE with a population of 200,000. The location of Paraguay’s international airport, known for its fine jewelry and silver craftsmanship. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
